throughputPlan.currentParentReason: Fresh COLA promotes N5.4.A profitability audit/preflight after N5.3.H LISTO_REAL. Existing VentaDetalle.CostoUnitarioSnapshot, VentaService cost capture, current sales-report service/API/UI and cost-authority documentation provide six non-overlapping inspection facets. These are bounded preflight deliverables; no N5.4.B+ implementation is authorized yet.

roadmap.note: N5.3.H is LISTO_REAL. N5.4.A is current by canonical COLA order. N5.4.B remains dependency-gated until A is REVIEW_FIRST certified.

J1.prompt: Read only docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md as operational authority and the live N5.4.A COLA scope. Inspect source-backed backend/data authorities for sales, historical cost and profitability inputs: VentaDetalle.CostoUnitarioSnapshot, Venta/VentaDetalle totals, VentaService cost capture, ReporteVentasService query shapes and N1.10 costing authority. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_A_BACKEND_DATA_PREFLIGHT.md with factual authorities, historical-snapshot semantics, gaps, dependencies, risks and acceptance criteria for venta/costo/margen by product/category/seller/customer. Do not implement N5.4.B+ formulas or schemas. Desarrollo only.

J2.prompt: Using docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md and live source only, inspect the domain/contract semantics needed for profitability: sale amount, historical cost snapshot, gross margin amount/percentage and grouping by product/category/seller/customer. Determine what formula/rounding/zero-cost semantics are already source-backed and explicitly identify any unresolved contract instead of inventing one. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_A_DOMAIN_CONTRACT_PREFLIGHT.md. No implementation of N5.4.B+. Desarrollo only.

J3.prompt: Using docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md and live frontend source, inspect the existing Centro de Reportes / sales-report UI for reusable models, filters, loading/empty/error/accessibility/responsive patterns relevant to a future profitability report grouped by product/category/seller/customer. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_A_FRONTEND_UX_PREFLIGHT.md with factual reuse points, gaps and acceptance implications. Do not implement N5.4.B+ or new UI. Desarrollo only.

J4.prompt: Using docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md and live security/RBAC/audit source, inspect authorization and information-disclosure implications of exposing cost/margin profitability data. Identify existing relational grants, seller scoping, audit/correlation patterns and whether cost visibility requires a source-backed stricter permission; never invent a permission. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_A_SECURITY_RBAC_PREFLIGHT.md. No implementation. Desarrollo only.

J5.prompt: Using docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md and live API/tests, inspect reusable HTTP/query validation, pagination/sorting, ProblemDetails, authorization, audit and contract-test harnesses for a future profitability report. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_A_API_TEST_PREFLIGHT.md with concrete test matrix and causal gate implications. Do not add tests or endpoints yet. Desarrollo only.

J6.prompt: Using docs/VAEP_AUTHORITY.md and live persistence/CI/observability source, inspect whether N5.4 profitability requires schema/migration changes or can remain a read model over existing sales/cost snapshots; identify index/performance, integration, rollback, correlation/logging and CI implications. Write only docs/qa/N5_4_A_INTEGRATION_ROLLBACK_PREFLIGHT.md. Never run Production or implement N5.4.B+. Desarrollo only.
